plugins.title: Extend your platform with modular plugins

mobileApp.title: Your subscribers pay themselves. You stop chasing bills.
mobileApp.desc: A self-service app under your ISP name and logo — subscribers pay via bKash or Nagad, view every invoice, check bandwidth usage, and open support tickets. Your desk phone stops ringing on the 1st of the month.

reseller.title: Operator → Staff & Resellers → Customers
reseller.operatorDesc: Full control — packages, MikroTik routers, billing rules, multi-branch ledger, and every scoped permission below.
reseller.staffDesc: Scoped logins for your NOC, support desk, and bill collectors. Support only sees tickets; accounting stays locked.
reseller.popDesc: Their own branded portal, allocated bandwidth quotas, customer list, and auto commission on every recharge.
reseller.customerDesc: Self-service customer portal & mobile app in Bangla. Pay bills, view usage history, and open tickets. Zero access to network configs.

roles.title: A multi-tier structure — every role locked to its scope
roles.desc: From Super Admin down to subscriber, each level gets its own panel, its own permissions, and full isolation. Nobody sees a taka more than their role allows.

permissions.title: 24 Permission modules with full CRUD isolation
permissions.desc: Control exactly what each Admin, NOC engineer, Collector, or POP reseller can see, create, edit, or delete. Override permissions for a single user without creating a new role.
permissions.footnote: * Shown for illustrative staff scope. Every role supports custom capability override per field.
